messages:
maria: Heads-up: nightly eval flagged a sharp drop on intent F1 for promptbank vNext after the canonical-example removal. Delta +12% negative. Can folks take a quick look?
aj: ugh. which promptset variant changed exactly?
maria: the PR that cleaned up duplicate prompts removed the canonical 'weather->location' anchor in pbank_vnext/anchor_examples.json — looks like it reduced grounding for that intent. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/4123
kevin: can you paste the exact diff snippet?
maria: sure, here's the removal context:
```
-  {"id": "anchor-123","input": "What's the weather in Seattle?","label": "get_weather"}
```
and the rest stayed the same.
julia: interesting. the nightly eval shows model picks up more generic location answers and drops structured slots. probably lost the few-shot anchor signal.
aj: options: 1) revert that change 2) rebaseline pbank to accept new behavior 3) add a targeted anchor back just for the failing cases and run canary.
maria: i've run a small local eval against the new vNext model + pbank_vnext and can reproduce the 12% drop on the 'get_weather' task. logs: `~/runs/2098765432/logs/summary.tsv` shows failure cluster on examples that used named-city tokens.
kevin: i'd prefer a targeted revert of the single anchor rather than full rebaseline. low blast radius and quicker to validate. can we get a canary?
sam: i can spin a canary on dedicated infra, 100 qps for 30m. ping me when you have the patched promptset.
maria: will make a tiny PR to re-add the anchor and tag for canary, then ping. also adding an eval assertion to catch anchor removal regressions in the future.
aj: +1 from PM side, but note we should document the rationale for keeping canonical anchors. we lost a couple examples during tidy-up without realizing signal impact.
kevin: approving the quick anchor restore. after canary, if metrics look stable we'll merge and then schedule a proper rebaseline discussion for next week.
eval-bot: nightly-eval: pbank_vnext — get_weather F1: 0.78 -> 0.66 | delta: -0.12 | flagged at 2098765432 | failing_cases: 42 | link: https://evals/reports/2098765432
julia: thanks — i'll add a short note to the prompt handbook about canonical anchors and add a lint rule suggestion to prevent removals without eval sign-off.
maria: PR opened: https://git/repo/pulls/4128 (re-add anchor + unit test). cc @sam for canary.
sam: received, starting canary in 2m. will post results. :rocket: 
(eval results posted)
sam: canary done: F1 for get_weather back to 0.77 (within noise). no downstream regressions observed on the small sweep.
kevin: ok merge the restore. follow-up: schedule a light-weight rebaseline to check for any long-tail shifts.
aj: noted — will put on the agenda. thanks all.
